text: f. Calculate producer surplus and consumer surplus for American buyers and sellers in the mousepad market now that it is open to free trade. How does it compare to the setting with a price ceiling but no trade? How does it compare to the setting with no price controls or trade with other countries? g. Concerned for the well-being of U.S. mousepad producers, the U.S. government institutes a $2 tariff on imported mousepads. Calculate the producer surplus, consumer surplus, government revenue, and deadweight loss from this policy.
